339-677-2079-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-2079-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2034-2415-4446.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6798-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6798-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

4125-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4125-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1895-2146-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-1739-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-5957-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-5957-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Kianne triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

2033-3499-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-3499-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-3499-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

7362-7743.notablePrerequisites:
Casey has lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
7362-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Casey.
Casey triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

460-539-7488.description:
Activate Topiary Lecturer by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Topiary Lecturer.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

889-1618-2440-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
889-1618-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
889-1618-2440-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

140-586-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3459-5078-5243-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4785-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

147-997-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

339-677-4359-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3090-5147-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
3090-5147-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

801-4763-4955-6068.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2292-4068.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-961-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-4823.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1339-1786-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1786-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God and Queza trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1849-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

3259-4068-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1770-4813-5003-5147.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
1770-4813-5003-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

803-1593-4508-5184-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1593-4508-5184-5299.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Furnace Celebration triggers, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Furnace Celebration triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal two damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1864-3000-4050.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-3000-4050.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep and 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Prossh and two Kobold and/or Squirrel tokens, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Choose to return Prossh to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Kobold or Squirrel, adding {1}.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

914-1927-2234-3094.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1927-2234-3094.description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Baral's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Lithoform Engine from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2308-4616.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-4616.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

397-997-4871.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Citizen.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

973-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

369-2034-2961.notablePrerequisites: False Demise attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2034-2961.description:
Sacrifice Iridescent Drake to Ashnod's Altar.
False Demise returns Iridescent Drake to the battlefield.
Iridescent Drake returns False Demise to the battlefield attached to itself.
Repeat.

1987-2781-4344.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Lumbering Battlement and any land you control.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1627-1909-2232.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala and Llanowar Elves do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power four or greater.
527-1627-1909-2232.description:
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Llanowar Elves to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Llanowar Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Wirewood Symbiote enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning nothing to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
